about: List price per 1M input tokens (USD, base rate: the STANDARD list price (Ümit #4238), standard tier, short-context, uncached, no batch, introductory/launch/promotional or off-peak discount) from the maker's own price page, for every leaderboard or Did-they-improve model whose maker states no total parameter count (model_params.json card_total_b null; Ümit #4245) (closed models, and open models without a disclosed total). Ümit's JOB 2 FINAL (#4217): these models are classed by this price (Efficient <= $0.50, Workhorse > $0.50 to $3, Flagship > $3); open models with a disclosed total are classed by it (model_params.json). weights: open or closed. input_per_mtok null: no price on the maker's page for this model (never estimated); such a model has no class. read: the date the page was read. provisional: true where the maker publishes only an introductory/launch price for the model (that price is used; provisional_reason says why); the label then reads 'Closed · <class> (provisional)'.
